Asks.description:
What happens to the answer of an ask: where an agent's ask can run a command, and how an
outside ask's answer reaches the session that asked.

deliver.description:
The command that delivers an answer to the session that asked, relative to the factory
folder. It gets the ask's id, revision, session, `answered` or `dismissed`, and the answer
as its arguments. Without it, the answer is only stored.

targets.description:
The folders, besides the task's worktree, where an answer can run an ask's command, by
name. A relative folder is under the factory folder.

secret_env.description: The environment variable that holds the webhook's secret, never the secret itself.

Resource.description: A resource the room check measures.

run.description: A shell command, run by `sh -c` in `PRIORY_HOME`.

timeout.description: How long it may run before Priory kills it; 5 minutes when unset.

when.description: The resource whose shortage runs the script.

Search.description: How tasks are found: who writes their TL;DR, and whether search compares embeddings too.

command.description: A command that reads text on stdin and prints a JSON array of floats, instead of `model`.

embeddings.description: Whether search compares embeddings of TL;DRs as well as keywords.

model.description: The embedding model Priory runs in process, a Hugging Face repository.

tldr.description: The agent whose model writes a new task's TL;DR; no summarizer runs without one.

Serve.description: The HTTP server over the factory's state, in the daemon and in `priory serve`.

listen.description: The address and port to listen on; a loopback address unless `public` is set.

public.description: Whether `listen` may be an address beyond this machine.

token_env.description: The environment variable that holds the token clients send, never the token itself.

web.description: Whether to serve the web view's files as well as `/api`.

Sweep.description:
How the daemon frees room: the built-in worktree sweep, the person's scripts, and the sweeper
agent it starts when they do not free enough.

after.description:
How long the queue stays stalled after its scripts ran before the sweeper starts; 30 minutes
when unset.

agent.description: The agent of the built-in `sweep` workflow; no sweeper starts without one.

every.description: How often the built-in worktree sweep runs; every 10 minutes when unset.

repo.description: The repository the sweeper works in and files its issue on, a GitHub `owner/name`.

scripts.description: Scripts run when the resource they name stalls the queue.

Telemetry.description: Where the daemon exports its trace records as OpenTelemetry spans.

otlp.description: The OTLP/HTTP base URL, such as `http://127.0.0.1:4318`; spans go to its `/v1/traces`.

Webhooks.description: The signed webhooks the HTTP server accepts, by source.

description: `factory.toml` or `factory.yaml`: the factory's name and the daemon's settings.

bands.description: The bands, highest first, when they are not the default ones.

command_timeout.description: How long one git, gh or tmux command may run before Priory kills it.

handler.description: The agent whose model reads a stalled run's screen; no handler runs without one.

stalled.description: How long a run goes without a hook event or a change on its pane before it counts as stalled.
